description: Evaluates Stage 3 Turn-by-Turn Roleplay Structure & Pagination

evals.prompt: Role-play the first turn where a user asks for available hotel rooms in Paris next Friday.
evals.expected_output: A complete role-play turn documenting 6 turn elements including pagination in tool response.
assertions: The role-play turn documents user utterance, agent intent, tool invocation, structured JSON tool response with pagination (page_size, total_count), site UI reaction, and agent response
